verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents official OpenFeature providers that can be used in place of its own SDKs. That lets a platform engineer write flag code against the vendor-neutral OpenFeature API rather than LaunchDarkly's SDK API. missing for 10: a list of which languages/SDKs have providers (docs say only "several"), feature-parity details versus the native SDKs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can use the vendor through OpenFeature providers so my flag code isn't locked to one vendor's SDK API

citations.quote: LaunchDarkly offers official OpenFeature providers for several of our SDKs... You can use these providers in your application in place of a LaunchDarkly SDK.
